items.title: Roy Palmer Interview, 1955-09-22
items.q: The interviewee addresses 'Russell' directly ('It wasn't no work, Russell.'), indicating the interviewer is named Russell. No other person named Russell is mentioned in the context.

ctx.x: All of a sudden they go to pieces. Yeah, all to pieces. And it seems like they worry a lot, you know, about, you know, I used to worry about nothing. And eat plenty. Do like you and me. Get your food and have a nice meal. And don't run out and get drunk and all that stuff. Laying out in the snow. That's bad. Yeah, if you take care of yourself, it's better. That's the better, you know, because even so, man, I have a million years to live in. You just might as well enjoy it and take, you know, do the best of it you…
Can you tell me about Freddie Keppard?
